Software Engineering Intern, Quillmark Freight, Columbus, OH | May 2025 - Aug 2025
- Built a REST endpoint in Java and Spring Boot that returns shipment ETAs for the customer portal, serving about 40,000 requests a day
- Cut the endpoint's p95 latency from 820 ms to 310 ms by adding a Redis cache and batching two database queries
- Wrote 60 unit and integration tests with JUnit and Testcontainers, raising the service's coverage from 54% to 78%
- Moved the service's build from Jenkins to GitHub Actions with a Docker image per pull request

Teaching Assistant, Data Structures, Harrowgate State University | Jan 2024 - May 2026
- Led two weekly lab sections of 30 students on linked lists, trees, graphs and hashing in C++
- Wrote an autograder in Python that checks 12 assignments, used by 4 sections each term

PROJECTS
CampusRide - carpool matching app (React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL)
- Built a web app that matches riders to drivers by route overlap; 350 students signed up in its first semester
- Designed the PostgreSQL schema and a matching query using PostGIS that answers in under 100 ms

KVLite - a key-value store (Go)
- Implemented a log-structured key-value store with write-ahead logging, compaction and a gRPC API
- Added Raft-based replication across 3 nodes for a Distributed Systems course project
